main.content: These are some of the significant [[dynamic event]]s that happen on a set timer. They include [[world boss]]es as well as [[meta event]]s in various [[expansion]] and [[Living World]] zones. You can reach this page from the game by entering /wiki et into the in-game chat box. The event timer is customizable: event bars can be hidden using the [x] in the top-right corner of each bar, repositioned by dragging, and further adjusted using the settings panel below. For a complete list of available options, see: [[Widget:Event timer#Features|Feature documentation]]. __NOTOC__ {{Event timer|exclude=festival-lc,festival-db}} == Related items == * [[World Boss Portal Device]] — a [[Gem Store]] item that announces the occurrence of [[world boss]]es in the in-game chat and allows instant teleportation to their locations. * [[Ley-Infused Lodestone]] — a gizmo purchased from [[Magister Ela Makkay]] or [[Sarettokk]] that indicates the current or next map for the Ley-Line Anomaly. * [[Maguuma Pact Operation Portal Device]] — a Gem Store item that announces the occurrence of [[meta event]]s within the [[Heart of Maguuma]] and instant teleportation to their locations. * [[Hero's Choice Chest]] — a type of a daily reward from several [[meta event]]s in [[expansion]] [[zone]]s. == See also == * [[World boss]] — for a more detailed world boss event schedule covering 24 hours. * [[Daily#Daily|Daily]] — for a list of today's daily achievements including fractals. * [[Dry Top/event table]] — for the list of events that begin in [[Dry Top]] every 5 minutes. * [[Defeat the invading Awakened]] — for the xx:30 hourly Awakened Invasions. * [[Catch Brand crystals and use them to disrupt the rift]] — Pre for Riftstalker Events every 10 minutes (xx:x0). * [[Wizard's Vault]] for the Wizard's Vault objectives and rewards. == Trivia == * This page is based on the [http://gw2.ninja/timer Guild Wars 2 Event Timer] by reddit user [https://www.reddit.com/user/fffam Fffam] and [https://twitch.tv/rediche Rediche].
